title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
notes: Introduced the imitation game (Turing Test) and proposed machine learning via child-machine analogies.

title: The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain
notes: First hardware implementation of a single-layer neural network perceptron at Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory.

title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors
notes: Demonstrated that backpropagation can generate useful internal representations in multi-layer neural networks.

title: Long Short-Term Memory
notes: Introduced constant error carousels and multiplicative gates to solve vanishing/exploding gradients in RNNs.

title: Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition (LeNet-5)
notes: Established modern ConvNet architecture (convolutions, subsampling, fully connected layers) for OCR.

title: NVIDIA CUDA Compute Architecture Launch
notes: Opened massively parallel GPU threads to general-purpose scientific computing via C/C++ abstractions.

title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
notes: Won ImageNet 2012 with 15.3% top-5 error, proving GPU acceleration and ReLU activations on deep architectures.

title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
notes: Introduced continuous Bag-of-Words (CBOW) and Skip-gram algorithms for continuous dense semantic embeddings.

title: Generative Adversarial Nets
notes: Introduced minimax game between generator and discriminator for generative density estimation without explicit likelihoods.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
notes: Introduced identity shortcut connections allowing stable optimization of 152+ layer deep networks.

title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
notes: Combined deep policy/value networks with Monte Carlo Tree Search to defeat 18-time world champion Lee Sedol.

title: In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit
notes: Google disclosed custom 28nm ASIC ASIC matrix multiplier delivering 15x-30x speedup over contemporary CPUs/GPUs.

title: Attention Is All You Need
notes: Replaced recurrent and convolutional sequence transduction with Multi-Head Scaled Dot-Product Self-Attention.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
notes: Introduced Masked Language Modeling (MLM) and Next Sentence Prediction on bidirectional Transformer encoders.

title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training
notes: First autoregressive generative pre-trained decoder transformer adapted to downstream tasks via supervised fine-tuning.

title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
notes: Demonstrated zero-shot task execution without parameter updates on a 1.5B parameter causal transformer.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
notes: Demonstrated in-context few-shot learning capabilities scaling to 175B parameters.

title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
notes: Solved 50-year protein folding challenge using Evoformer attention and invariant point attention structure modules.

title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
notes: Contrastive pre-training linking 400M image-text pairs into shared multimodal embedding space.

title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
notes: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (PPO) aligning generative completion to helpful, honest, harmless intent.

title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
notes: Cross-attention guided latent space diffusion enabling consumer GPU high-resolution text-to-image synthesis.

title: NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU Architecture Whitepaper
notes: 4nm TSMC chip with 80B transistors, Transformer Engine with FP8 precision, delivering 4x speedup over A100.

title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
notes: Proved that training smaller models (7B-65B) on more tokens (1.4T) outperforms overparameterized models under fixed compute.

title: GPT-4 Technical Report
notes: Large multimodal model achieving human-level performance on academic examinations. Exact parameter count not publicly disclosed.

title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet Model Card & Announcement
notes: Frontier intelligence model outperforming prior Claude 3 Opus at 2x speed. Exact parameters undisclosed.

title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
notes: Flagship 405B dense model trained on 15.6T tokens with 16k context on 16,000 H100 cluster.

title: Learning to Reason with LLMs (OpenAI o1)
notes: Inference-time chain-of-thought reinforcement learning allocating dynamic search compute before response generation.

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
notes: 671B parameter Mixture-of-Experts (37B active) with Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) trained for $5.9M on 2,048 H800 GPUs.

title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
notes: Demonstrated self-evolution of chain-of-thought reasoning using pure large-scale RL without supervised cold-start.
